groups.uiSourceDigestNote: Recaptured 2026-08-19 from the exact interface digest recorded here. Cheap Lowlevel launched the real Electron app on a named off-screen Windows desktop and performed the 36-action Adult/Kid journey plus the persisted failed-run removal journey. All 17 whole-window PNGs were decoded and visually inspected. The failed private workflow row restored as failed, exposed Remove from list, passed the two-key full-slider confirmation, and disappeared without removing the unrelated cancelled public row. Capture-only home and map-storage paths prevented host worlds, render records and profile paths from entering the pixels. Each promoted image has an exact source commit, built main-process artifact hash, interaction ledger, single-target privacy record, zero console/page errors, cleanup proof, byte-preserving transaction and active record in promoted-evidence.json. CDP only located visible controls and read assertions; every state change used Lowlevel input.
